findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 5906c15189bd2a3929301a696512229d848d82bf3f2bcdd0fe66766d1b18cebe; all 6 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.
The six controlled official HTML objects total 760,522 bytes and retain individual SHA-256 identities documented in the selection decision and article.
The PVS overview states the school-district taxable-value and state education-funding purpose; the 2025 final overview says the Comptroller certified 2025 findings on August 27, 2026.
The Reeves 2025 final-findings index identifies the two districts and exposes summary and deduction-detail links but no Category G worksheet links.
The Reeves 2024 final-findings index separately links Category G worksheets for Pecos-Barstow-Toyah ISD and Balmorhea ISD.
